interface Settings {
  title?: string;
  count?: number;
  enabled?: boolean;
  onChange?(): void;
}

class Defaults implements Settings {
  title: string | undefined = undefined;
  count: number | undefined;
  enabled?: boolean | undefined;
  onChange: (() => void) | undefined = undefined;

  constructor() {
    this.count = 3;
  }
}

class Explicit implements Settings {
  constructor(public title: string | undefined) {}
}

interface Reading {
  get value(): number | undefined;
}

class Sensor implements Reading {
  get value(): number | undefined {
    return 42;
  }
}

const defaults = new Defaults();
console.log(defaults.title, defaults.count, defaults.enabled, defaults.onChange);
console.log(new Explicit("hello").title, new Explicit(undefined).title);
console.log(new Sensor().value);
